scope.runtime: unmodified official installed Desktop and its bundled native CLI, default local sidecar only
scope.ui: official renderer controlled through externally enabled loopback CDP; real Home DOM session selection
scope.identity: native shell OPENCODE_SESSION_ID and full conversation reference endpoints
scope.model: scripted local provider; no real API key or model intelligence assertion
scope.onboarding: official firstLaunchOnboardingComplete setting seeded; first-run onboarding not tested
scope.recovery: Desktop-only reopen and ordinary service stop/start with the same configuration, database, port and credentials
